title: Beyond Classification: Task-Dependent Learnability under Privacy-Motivated Image Transformations
abstract: arXiv:2608.27066v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs) in computer vision often rely on noise or image perturbations to protect visual data while securely processing it, creating a trade-off between task performance and protection. This trade-off is commonly evaluated using image classification, which primarily captures semantic separability and remains robust despite significant geometric, spatial layout or local boundary alterations. As a result, it is too simplistic as a proxy for generic vision tasks. Exhaustive downstream-task evaluation, however, is computationally expensive because models must often be trained for each PET transformation and parameter setting. We therefore propose a compute-aware multi-task protocol for evaluating PETs in model training. It combines lightweight proxy tasks that target complementary aspects of visual structure while remaining simple and fast to compute. Across irreversible privacy transformations, key-based block

translated_title: 超越分类：隐私驱动图像变换下的任务依赖性可学习性
translated_abstract: 计算机视觉中的隐私增强技术（PETs）通常依赖噪声或图像扰动来保护视觉数据，同时安全地处理这些数据，从而在任务性能和保护之间产生权衡。这种权衡通常使用图像分类来评估，而图像分类主要捕捉语义可分性，并且尽管存在显著的几何、空间布局或局部边界变化，仍保持鲁棒性。因此，作为通用视觉任务的代理，它过于简单。然而，详尽的下游任务评估在计算上成本高昂，因为模型通常需要为每种PET变换和参数设置进行训练。因此，我们提出了一种计算感知的多任务协议，用于在模型训练中评估PETs。它结合了轻量级代理任务，这些任务针对视觉结构的互补方面，同时保持简单和快速计算。在不可逆的隐私变换中，基于密钥的块...
tldr: 提出了一种计算感知的多任务评估协议，通过轻量级代理任务来更有效地评估隐私增强图像变换对多种视觉任务的可学习性影响，克服了传统分类评估过于简单的问题。
en_tdlr: A compute-aware multi-task protocol is proposed to evaluate privacy-enhancing image transformations via lightweight proxy tasks, addressing the limitations of classification-only assessment for generic vision tasks.
